description.zh:
第n个计价模块的配置，n的取值范围为（1~50），格式：“AA:aa,BB:bb”，其中AA,BB分别为计价模块属性标识，aa,bb分别为计价模块属性的属性值。

> 可通过[DescribePricingModule](~~96469~~)接口获取Module参数。
description.en:
The configuration of the Nth pricing module. The value of N can be an integer from 1 to 50. The configuration is in the "AA:aa,BB:bb" format. In this format, AA and BB are the property codes of the pricing module, and aa and bb are the property values.

> Obtain the configuration by calling the [DescribePricingModule](~~96469~~) operation.

description.zh:
第n个计价模块的模块标识。


> 可通过[DescribePricingModule](~~96469~~)接口获取Module参数。
description.en:
The code of the Nth pricing module.

> Obtain the module code by calling the [DescribePricingModule](~~96469~~) operation.

description.zh:
第n个计价模块的价格类型，取值范围：
- Hour：小时价。
- Usage：使用量。
- Month：月价。
- Year：年价。

> 可通过[DescribePricingModule](~~96469~~)接口获取Module参数。
description.en:
The price type of the Nth pricing module. Valid values:

- Hour: hourly price.

- Usage: usage.

- Month: monthly price.

- Year: yearly price.

> Obtain the price type by calling the [DescribePricingModule](~~96469~~) operation.
The ID of the region where the instance resides.

description.zh: 订阅类型。取值类型：PayAsYouGo（后付费）。
description.en: The subscription type. Valid value: PayAsYouGo.

descriptions.zh:
### API描述
1. 调用QueryProductList获取产品code,参见[查询产品信息](~~95984~~)。
2. 调用DescribePricingModule接口获取产品的配置参数，参见[查询产品模块信息](~~96469~~)。
3. 根据查询到的产品配置参数调用本接口获取后付费产品的价格。
descriptions.en:
### API description

1. Call the QueryProductList operation to obtain the product code. For more information, see [Query product information](~~95984~~).

2. Call the DescribePricingModule operation to obtain the configuration parameters of the product. For more information, see [Query product module information](~~96469~~).

3. Call this operation with the obtained configuration parameters to query the prices of pay-as-you-go products.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi get-pay-as-you-go-price --product-code ecs --product-type ecs --subscription-type PayAsYouGo --biz-region cn-hangzhou --module-list ModuleCode=InstanceType Config=InstanceType:ecs.g5.xlarge,IoOptimized:IoOptimized,ImageOs:linux PriceType=Hour --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi GetPayAsYouGoPrice --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionType PayAsYouGo --ModuleList.1.PriceType Hour --ProductCode ecs --ModuleList.1.ModuleCode InstanceType --ModuleList.1.Config 'InstanceType:ecs.g5.xlarge,IoOptimized:IoOptimized,ImageOs:linux' --ProductType ecs --Region 'cn-hangzhou'
